description: Needs ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR: read one entry of a sandbox archive by byte ranges — access: 'range' opens the file through zipnative's openZipRange over the file's own handle (never a URL): the end record, the central directory and this entry's bytes are read, nothing else, so memory stays at the size of the central directory. A zipPath above the 1 GiB in-memory cap takes this path automatically (access: 'auto'); the result then carries access: 'range'.
